warehouse/31959.htm.text: Freighter Excel: Welcome! We can safeguard anything you'd like to leave with us. Better than carrying around a lot of nonessential weight...especially since you can reclaim any of it at any of our many convenient locations!

warehouse/31959-noteach.htm.text: Freighter Excel: Sorry, but I cannot teach you the skills you wish to learn. Better luck elsewhere, friend.
